problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a technician's maintenance tour across six regional facilities.

The travel times between facilities are recorded in minutes:
* Facility Alpha to Beta: 70.9 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Gamma: 82.2 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Delta: 23.5 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Epsilon: 113.3 minutes
* Facility Alpha to Zeta: 49.8 minutes
* Beta to Gamma: 37.9 minutes
* Beta to Delta: 94.2 minutes
* Beta to Epsilon: 77.2 minutes
* Beta to Zeta: 97.9 minutes
* Gamma to Delta: 102.1 minutes
* Gamma to Epsilon: 114.5 minutes
* Gamma to Zeta: 88.1 minutes
* Delta to Epsilon: 133.7 minutes
* Delta to Zeta: 44.7 minutes
* Epsilon to Zeta: 158.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circuit that allows the technician to perform a single service call at each facility precisely once before concluding back at the initial depot.
